title: Ghent, paving expenses in the 14th century - dataset
descriptions: This dataset contains information about the paving expenses made by Ghent's city government during the 14th century (1321-1389). Each line corresponds to one mention of paving location in the city account. Two columns correpond to the GIS identifer of the location.
